headline: Chip rout spills into Asia; Kioxia plunges as US futures bounce
tldr: US markets are closed today, Sunday Nov 1, and reopen Monday Nov 2 at 9:30 ET (8:30 SK). Friday's Intel-led chip rout hit MU, and Asian memory is weaker so far, so the early lean for Monday is flat to slightly lower despite modestly higher US futures.
